fields.statement: At b00d77a, go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/run-start-agent-session passes: with RHIZA_SESSION=01SESSIONFORTESTING, rhiza run start --workflow one exits 2 with 'run start refused: this is agent session 01SESSIONFORTESTING, and no agent session starts a run' and no .git/rhiza/runs; with RHIZA_SESSION empty the same start succeeds. By hand in a scratch repo with RHIZA_SESSION=abc-123, run start (plain and --json) exits 2 naming abc-123, and neither .git/rhiza nor a sibling run worktree is created. The diff puts the guard first in runRunStart, before the workflow is resolved or anything is written. make check exits 0.
